proposal:
Intent: Deliver D179's first Muse Code slice on the shared Windows laptop: assert the existing native install (version, PATH, launcher) with sign-in as a Dispatch-owned state, add a Muse availability and quota probe that records "not signed in" as its own state, and give voting seats a Muse event-log reader whose missing, unreadable, or Windows-path-unresolved session log is "no command source", never "clean".
Assumes: a named command_source reader whose log cannot be used already reports "no command source", and a backend with command_source "none" reports "unscanned"; this card extends that contract to Muse. Probe: tests/test_command_source.py::test_no_usable_transcript_raises_never_an_empty_clean_result; command_source.scan_entry (source outside ("claude","copilot") is unscanned); facilitator.run_backend passes {SESSION} into scan_entry only when the invocation contains {SESSION}. Also assumes Muse Code 1.4.14 is installed here and unsigned-in, and Dispatch owns `muse login`. Probe: .mob/records/276/dispatch-install-note.md; facilitator read-only `muse.cmd --version` printed "Muse Code 1.4.14 (1.4.14-R7309.1)" at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\muse\muse.cmd on the user PATH.

Domain-expert (T2) question: For mob-crosscli (backends, facilitator.run_backend / probe_drivers, command_source.py), what is the minimal, auditable event schema needed from Muse session logs so a vote reader can extract command executions and final vote text without a false "clean" when the command source is missing?

Domain-expert (T2) answer: Reuse the existing reader contract. Claude transcripts need an assistant record and tool_use.input.command; Copilot events.jsonl needs tool.execution_start with arguments.command; missing, empty, unparsable, or assistant-less files raise NoCommandSource. Muse's documented log is append-only JSONL, envelope `{sequence, recorded_at, record_type, durability, payload_type, payload}`, path `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/muse/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<session-id>/session.jsonl` (task-force finding (c)). On this Windows install the data root is %USERPROFILE%\.local\share\muse\ (local-tracing present; sessions/ absent while unsigned-in). Criterion 3 locates data_root from XDG_DATA_HOME, else HOME\.local\share, else USERPROFILE\.local\share, then muse\sessions\YYYY\MM\DD\<session-id>\session.jsonl. Tests inject `root`. `muse exec --session-id {SESSION}` pins the id so run_backend's uuid matches locate_muse. Schema: stream envelopes; a command is a payload with a tool name and a string command; vote text is run_backend stdout. Missing file, OSError, unusable data_root, or a log with no run/command-bearing record is "no command source".

This card proves without sign-in: C1 install facts, C2 unsigned-in probe state, C3 fixture reader and no-source cases. Waits on Dispatch `muse login` (product owner says ready): a cited Muse vote in a window. Also waits: build seats (D179); D178's detector (card 277; an empty vote opens a diagnosis, and only quota or unavailability excludes a model).

Criterion 1 (Done check 1): Install test of the existing Windows install.
Acceptance: a committed test in mob-defaults asserts muse.cmd on PATH, version "Muse Code 1.4.14 (1.4.14-R7309.1)", and launcher %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\muse\muse.cmd (that folder holds .muse-launcher.ps1 and muse-bin-1.4.14-R7309.1.exe). Sign-in is a separate Dispatch-owned state, currently "not signed in". No seat, red, or green runs install.ps1 or `muse login`.
ZOMBIES: Z PATH has no muse → install-missing recorded. O one resolved muse.cmd at the launcher path with that version passes. M several PATH hits: the resolved Get-Command/where.exe path is asserted. B version mismatch; launcher outside %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\muse; cmd shim without the exe. I PATH lookup and the absolute launcher path agree. E unreadable launcher; empty PATH; slash vs backslash. S other backends.json entries unchanged.
Test plan: red tests/test_muse_install.py fails until a helper returns version, resolved PATH, and launcher; green implements that helper against the live install (read-only). The run carries a D176 Environment line.
Cap: criterion 1, at most 1 cycles
no list input

Criterion 2 (Done check 2): Muse availability and quota probe.
Acceptance: core/backends.json has enabled muse; probe_drivers records it with the other drivers. "not signed in" is its own result state; it is distinct from quota-reached and from unavailable, and it does not set known_reset. The probe may call `muse --version` and `muse usage`. Unsigned-in Muse does not count as having quota for claude_only_problem or quota_first. Invocation includes {SESSION}.
ZOMBIES: Z muse disabled → evidence "disabled in backends.json", CLI not launched. O one muse result in state not-signed-in. M muse present with claude, copilot, grok, agy, codex in probes.json. B four outcomes: unsigned-in, quota-reached, unavailable, disabled. I backends.json pin, probe_backend, and probes.results["muse"] agree. E usage timeout or unreadable output is unavailable with that evidence, still distinct from quota. S tests/test_probe_model.py and tests/test_quota_first.py stay green.
Test plan: red tests/test_muse_probe.py with a fake CLI fails while unsigned-in is stored as quota or as available; a second case keeps quota-reached as quota. Green adds the muse backend with probe_model a key of its models map and classifies unsigned-in from usage/login text.
Cap: criterion 2, at most 1 cycles
Inputs: disabled: muse enabled false → disabled evidence; unknown: probe_model pin missing from models → probe fails and launches nothing; repeated: two muse-named backends (JSON object keys unique; n/a duplicate key); reordered: models map order leaves the pin unchanged.

Criterion 3 (Done check 3): Event-log reader for voting seats (adopted QA condition).
Acceptance: command_source source "muse". Windows session log path: %USERPROFILE%\.local\share\muse\sessions\YYYY\MM\DD\<session-id>\session.jsonl. Finding it: data_root = XDG_DATA_HOME, else HOME\.local\share, else USERPROFILE\.local\share; then muse\sessions\YYYY\MM\DD\<session-id>\session.jsonl. locate_muse(session, root=None) uses that layout; tests pass root. Missing, unreadable, or Windows-path-unresolved (no usable data_root from those variables) → NoCommandSource and scan_entry status "no command source", never "clean". backends.json command_source "muse". Voting seats only. A cited Muse vote in a window waits on sign-in.
ZOMBIES: Z missing session.jsonl → no-source. O one fixture envelope with a string command yields that command. M several envelopes; a repeat counted twice. B unresolved Windows root; mixed separators; empty jsonl; unparsable lines and no run record. I scan_entry(..., source="muse") and locate_muse share the path rule. E OSError; two matches; session id outside PLAIN_NAME; no file when logging was off. S claude and copilot readers, and source "none" → unscanned, stay as they are.
Test plan: red tests/test_command_source_muse.py first: missing, unreadable, and unresolved-root each assert no-source; then the D167 fixtures. Green: locate_muse plus an envelope reader that takes string commands from payload; scan_entry accepts "muse". Fixtures only.
Cap: criterion 3, at most 1 cycles
Inputs: disabled: muse omitted or command_source "none" → unscanned; unknown: unknown record_type/payload_type with no string command, and no run record → no-source; repeated: two folders for one session id → no-source; reordered: JSON field order ignored, commands in jsonl file order.

D167 hostile-input list (labels D175 C2; red answers each):
- disabled (C2): muse enabled false. SEEN: tests/test_probe_model.py disabled backend; tests/test_quota_first.py::test_guard_a_disabled_backend_counts_as_no_quota.
- unknown pin (C2): probe_model not a models key. SEEN: tests/test_probe_model.py AnUnusablePinFailsTheProbeAndLaunchesNothing.
- reordered models (C2): pin stable. SEEN: tests/test_probe_model.py::test_reordering_the_models_does_not_change_the_probe_model.
- repeated muse key (C2): INSURANCE (JSON object keys unique).
- disabled/none reader (C3): command_source "none" → unscanned. SEEN: core/backends.json grok/agy/codex "none"; tests/test_command_scan_files_2b.py::test_S_a_none_backend_is_still_unscanned.
- unknown envelope (C3): INSURANCE.
- repeated Muse session (C3): two matches → no-source. SEEN for Copilot (locate_copilot; tests/test_command_scan_files_2b.py two matches). INSURANCE for Muse.
- reordered envelopes (C3): file order. SEEN for Claude: tests/test_command_source.py::test_commands_come_back_in_file_order_with_a_repeat_counted_twice. INSURANCE for Muse.
- missing session.jsonl (C3, adopted): no-source. SEEN: tests/test_command_source.py missing_transcript.jsonl; adopted condition QA w276tf2-qa in .mob/records/decisions/276-taskforce.json.
- unreadable log (C3, adopted): OSError → no-source. SEEN: command_source._read_transcript OSError branch. INSURANCE for a real Muse session.jsonl (none on disk).
- Windows-path-unresolved (C3, adopted): no usable data_root → no-source. SEEN as the unpublished Windows mapping: 276 task-force finding (c); on this machine %USERPROFILE%\.local\share\muse\ exists. The env-root failure is the fixture.

D176 note: every gate or suite run used as acceptance evidence opens with an Environment line (shell and launch form, working directory, git rev-parse HEAD, command, test count, seconds). A run without that line is not evidence. The reference shell is the one named in the gate brief from the greens and the facilitator.
